recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the Published FHIR-7837 request in the current core build, and no broader MedicationStatement v2 mapping policy work is needed unless Pharmacy chooses to reopen that topic separately.
issue_request: FHIR-7837 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy DSTU1 QA request to blank the MedicationStatement patient v2 mapping by removing PID-3-Patient ID List because MedicationStatement is not a v2 transaction-domain concept and mapping from a v2 message with a patient was not expected to be a likely scenario.
initial_application: The 2015 batch commit 5bb461af1063efe577bac2b8b17b6992be7560bf explicitly named tracker 7837, but comparison of the MedicationStatement spreadsheet before and after the commit showed the PID-3 patient mapping still present while adjacent RXA/RXR/RAS mappings were removed. Later MedicationStatement/MedicationUsage refactors carried the mapping into XML, and b9257918056a31ebdc080627432cc94db78637e0 only normalized the punctuation to PID-3 Patient ID List while applying unrelated changes.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to Pharmacy, so source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml is in current build scope. Before reconciliation, the only element-level HL7 v2 mapping left in the current MedicationStatement source was the subject PID-3 mapping. Related MedicationStatement v2 mapping cleanup issues such as FHIR-7838 and FHIR-7839 are already represented on the combined branch, and corrected Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later decision or community record reintroducing PID-3 for MedicationStatement.
reconciliation: Removed the v2 mapping block from MedicationStatement.subject in source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml, leaving workflow, w5, and RIM mappings intact. The top-level v2 mapping identity remains because current StructureDefinition sources can retain mapping namespace declarations without element rows; the semantic fix is removing the subject row's PID-3 map value.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml: removed the MedicationStatement.subject mapping block with identity v2 and map value PID-3 Patient ID List.
